---
title: "Анимация модели SIR"
format: html
---

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: true

# 1. Paketlerin Yüklenmesi ve Ortam
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(normpath(joinpath(@__DIR__, "../../..")))
using DrWatson
@quickactivate "project"

using Plots
using DataFrames
using CSV
using JLD2

include(srcdir("SIRPetri.jl"))
using .SIRPetri

# 2. Verinin Güvenli Yüklenmesi (Zaman serisi verisi)
try
    global df_det = wload(datadir("df_det.jld2"))["df_det"]
catch
    try
        global df_det = CSV.read(datadir("sir_det.csv"), DataFrame)
    catch
        β = 0.3
        γ = 0.1
        tmax = 100.0
        net, u0, _ = build_sir_network(β, γ)
        global df_det = simulate_deterministic(net, u0, (0.0, tmax), saveat = 1.0, rates = [β, γ])
    end
end

# 3. Анимация (Animasyon Oluşturma - Tek Hücrede)
println("Создание анимации...")
anim = @animate for i in 1:nrow(df_det)
    plot(
        df_det.time[1:i], 
        [df_det.S[1:i] df_det.I[1:i] df_det.R[1:i]],
        label = ["S" "I" "R"],
        xlim = (0, maximum(df_det.time)),
        ylim = (0, maximum([maximum(df_det.S), maximum(df_det.I), maximum(df_det.R)]) * 1.1),
        xlabel = "Time",
        ylabel = "Population",
        title = "SIR Model Animation",
        linewidth = 2
    )
end

# 4. Kaydetme ve Çıktı
gif_path = plotsdir("sir_animation.gif")
gif(anim, gif_path, fps = 15)
println("Анимация сохранена в: ", gif_path)
